title: nixos/traefik: refactor
reason: Applicable: real traefik module + wired test. Real diff is a very large restructuring: staticConfigOptions/dynamicConfigOptions renamed+restructured into static.settings/dynamic.files.<name>.settings via real mkRenamedOptionModule entries, format engine changed toml->json.
targets_toml: single target traefik, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,traefik], watch=[static].

additional_raw_facts_for_reviewer.note: NOT a blackout -- 13 real options ARE discovered for this file (enable, static.file, static.settings, dynamic.*, dataDir, user, group, ...). `static` itself resolves not-found only because it is a submodule CONTAINER (its own leaves static.file/static.settings are found individually), same correct-by-construction shape as gotenberg's pdfEngines in S5-A batch7 -- not a gap, a targeting-granularity artifact of watching a container name instead of one of its leaves.
